text:
Samir Patel: Follow-up from postmortem: we need a concrete alert-tuning plan to stop late-night pages. Primary issues: duplicate pages during rollouts and low-threshold flapping during autoscale.

Maria Gomez: I captured 4 items in the PM draft. We should assign owners and short deadlines.

Jin Park: Items: 1) relax Pod CPU alert for non-prod (threshold+for). 2) add fingerprinting to dedupe rollout events. 3) label-based routing to avoid paging for rollout/autoscale noise. 4) PD suppression rules (burst/exponential).

Alex Chen: For (1) propose: non-prod rule -> 80% for 5m; prod stays 90% for 1m. I'll drop the sample alert into the PR.

Priya Rao: For (2) use fingerprint = cluster + pod_template_hash so restarts during rolling update don't create new fingerprints. I'll run a staging canary.

Maria Gomez: For (3) add rollout=true label at deploy time. Alertmanager: severity=info for rollout or namespace=staging, route to Slack only. No page.

Jin Park: For (4) PagerDuty only fires if >3 unique fingerprints in 15m OR >5 pages in 5m. Otherwise send to #eng-oncall-snooze. I'll draft the PD policy.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-20260321 linked to PM.

Samir Patel: Owners & deadlines: Maria -> PR with rule changes (EOD Fri 2026-03-27). Jin -> PD policy + runbook snippet (Tue 2026-03-24). Alex -> dashboards + synthetic (Wed 2026-03-25). Priya -> fingerprint canary in staging (Thu 2026-03-26).

Maria Gomez: Will open PR and tag reviewers. I'll add unit tests for the alert lines.

Priya Rao: Canary started in staging tonight, will post results here. If dedupe looks good, plan prod rollout next week.

Alex Chen: I'll add Grafana panel tracking unique fingerprints per 15m and pages per service per 7d to measure impact.

Jin Park: Also propose an "alert churn" info alert: >=10 alerts from same service in 10m -> notify channel (no page). If repeats 3x in 1h escalate to warning and start paging path.

Samir Patel: Good. Let's reconvene Thu 11:00 (15m) to validate staging and confirm prod rollout. Meeting invite incoming. If anyone misses a deadline, ping me directly. Goal: >=90% reduction in pages from this class and close PM follow-ups next week. :rocket:
